body:
We need to make sure we also have a lore where on the home Raya planet landscape we have something like untouched nature + lots of high white acoustic transmission and telecom towers. Characters have futuristic 
tight clothing primary white. Characters can be found walking, playing or flying acoustically, they can some with or without their spherical while robotic companions, that serve as electro magnetic transmitters for telepathy internet.

So when games have loading screens or have something on background, we should use our Raya planet landscape and environment shown.

So spherical bots also provide our human-like characters with telekinesis, for example we can have scenes where characters copy an apple from a tree without ever damaging it. The Raya planet society is highly ethical and moral by default. So they are in harmony with nature, don't damage it. Yet the poses magic like technologies to be able to scan and copy apples and other things by using electromagnetic and acoustic levitation and so on. The laws of the system are entirely optional, yet defaults are very peaceful, if two citizen decide to disable some laws/rules, they can do totally so, by immediately applying via telepathy internet to the system. But by default spherical bots can take neural control other parts of bodies of citizen and provide impossibility of doing damaging actions to self or other citizens. Each citizen can think anything, but their control over muscles in the body can be overridden to prevent damage to self and other citizens by default. Yet each citizen has a right to disable these rules enforcement on themselves.

Also as per electromagnetic manipulation all citizen are immortal and forever young like in 18-21 years range. Old people are rare, and only if decided to disable automatic wellness treatment by the system.

Double check nothing in the lore contradicts this vision. And you can expand on in details it to make it more realistic and provide ideas on different scenery pilots. So we later will be able to picture them.

Also we should have a list of games that will be sorted by how simple the development is (by listing of algorithms needed) and estimated codebase size, assets listed and so on. Each our game should have detailed estimated plan on how much assets, algorithms and so on must be developed, so we can score games by complexity.

We also need to make sure have ideas of all typical games for toddlers from 1-3 years and so on.

So we also need to rate each game on how likely toddler will able to learn how to play it, so we will start developing games, that are easy to play and easy to develop first.

Double check all details, lore, descriptions are detailed as they can get.

Also make a GitHub Page website to present all the data we have.

So we have games ideas, lore descriptions (some stories and so on), so it is interesting to read, yet have some wisdom transfer and so on, if no concept are images are generated we should have concept image descriptions and so on.

Make sure everything is consistent and don't contradict the latest vision I was talking about.

Shacados planet is much darker, where we see no advanced tech, most people are poor or/and being exploited, they have shortage of food and so on. The planet is mostly rusty and dusty surface with lots of junk everywhere and so on. Using oil, coal, gas and other polluting chemicals and sources of energy. Some water sources and forests still exist but mostly dying, polluted and so on. In some places planet is frozen to barely livable conditions and so on.

We may also have some games in that style too, at least we need to have concept art.

So the Shacados is still space travel capable, but in least advanced and unsafe way possible.

So you focus on lore, description and website, later other agent will work with image generation and so on.

Website must be mobile first, so it will be each to browse games ideas to select what we will develop first.
